def quat_slerp(a, b, t: float) -> np.ndarray:
    a = np.asarray(a, np.float64); b = np.asarray(b, np.float64)
    d = float(np.dot(a, b))
    if d < 0:
        b, d = -b, -d
    if d > 0.9995:
        q = a + t * (b - a)
        return q / np.linalg.norm(q)
    th = math.acos(min(1.0, d))
    return (math.sin((1 - t) * th) * a + math.sin(t * th) * b) / math.sin(th)


def hex_rgb(h: str) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
    h = h.strip().lstrip("#")
    return tuple(int(h[i:i + 2], 16) / 255.0 for i in (0, 2, 4))


def srgb_to_linear(c):
    c = np.asarray(c, np.float64)
    return np.where(c <= 0.04045, c / 12.92, ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4)

+def width_to_press_mm(width_mm):
+    # Width(z) = 1.187 z(cm) - 0.03 cm.
+    return max(0.65, (float(width_mm) + 0.30) / 1.187)
+
+
+def offset_for_press_mm(press_mm):
+    z_cm = min(1.5, max(0.0, float(press_mm) / 10.0))
+    off_cm = -0.967 * z_cm * z_cm + 2.109994 * z_cm - 0.036001727
+    return max(0.0, off_cm) / 100.0
+
+
+def make_curve(nodes, width_nodes):
+    pts = np.asarray(nodes, dtype=np.float64)
+    seg = np.linalg.norm(np.diff(pts, axis=0), axis=1)
+    ss = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(seg)]
+    cx = CubicSpline(ss, pts[:, 0], bc_type="natural")
+    cy = CubicSpline(ss, pts[:, 1], bc_type="natural")
+    ww = PchipInterpolator(ss, np.asarray(width_nodes, dtype=np.float64))
+    return ss, cx, cy, ww
+
+
+def evaluate_stroke(name, nodes, widths, step_px):
+    ss, cx, cy, ww = make_curve(nodes, widths)
+    arc = np.arange(0.0, ss[-1], step_px)
+    if len(arc) == 0 or arc[-1] < ss[-1]:
+        arc = np.r_[arc, ss[-1]]
+    u, v = cx(arc), cy(arc)
+    du, dv = cx(arc, 1), cy(arc, 1)
+    # Tangent in the world's x,y frame. Image columns map to -world-y, rows to -world-x.
+    tx, ty = -dv, -du
+    norm = np.maximum(1e-8, np.hypot(tx, ty))
+    tx, ty = tx / norm, ty / norm
+    press = np.asarray([width_to_press_mm(w) for w in ww(arc)])
+    # Keep tapered terminals light, while retaining enough width to survive the 0.5 ink threshold.
+    return arc, u, v, tx, ty, press
+
+
+def move_to(s, p, pos, speed=0.04, settle=0):
+    r = p["move_tip"](np.asarray(pos, dtype=np.float64), speed=speed, settle=settle)
+    if r["ik_failures"]:
+        print("move_tip IK failures", r)
+    return r
+
+
+def draw_path(s, nodes, widths, name):
+    p = s.primitives()
+    arc, u, v, tx, ty, press_mm = evaluate_stroke(name, nodes, widths, step_px=3.35)
+    # Position the brush in the air just behind the first point so theta is initialized
+    # to the writing direction before ink first touches the sheet.
+    u0, v0 = float(u[0]), float(v[0])
+    pre_x, pre_y = s.geo.px_to_world(u0, v0)
+    pre_x -= float(tx[0]) * 0.006
+    pre_y -= float(ty[0]) * 0.006
+    move_to(s, p, [pre_x, pre_y, 0.036], speed=0.04)
+    start_x, start_y = s.geo.px_to_world(u0, v0)
+    move_to(s, p, [start_x, start_y, 0.036], speed=0.018, settle=2)
+
+    # Lower at the stroke head. The pressure profile is already tapered there.
+    z0 = 0.020 - press_mm[0] / 1000.0
+    move_to(s, p, [start_x, start_y, z0], speed=0.010, settle=3)
+
+    prev_q = s.hold_action().astype(np.float64)
+    fail = 0
+    for i in range(1, len(arc)):
+        off = offset_for_press_mm(press_mm[i])
+        # The root follows behind the handle by Offset(z); lead the handle by that
+        # amount so the flat edge of the mark follows the exemplar centreline.
+        x, y = s.geo.px_to_world(float(u[i]), float(v[i]))
+        x += off * float(tx[i])
+        y += off * float(ty[i])
+        z = 0.020 - float(press_mm[i]) / 1000.0
+        q, ok, err = s.ik([x, y, z], q_init=prev_q)
+        if not ok and err > 0.003:
+            fail += 1
+            # IK's returned q is still useful as a nearby seed if it is finite.
+        if not np.all(np.isfinite(q)):
+            q = prev_q
+            fail += 1
+        s.step(q)
+        prev_q = q
+    print(name, "samples", len(arc), "length_mm", round(float(arc[-1] * PX_M * 1000), 1), "ik_problem", fail)
+
+    # Lift clearly off the sheet to end this contact before travelling to the next stroke.
+    x, y = s.geo.px_to_world(float(u[-1]), float(v[-1]))
+    off = offset_for_press_mm(press_mm[-1])
+    x += off * float(tx[-1]); y += off * float(ty[-1])
+    move_to(s, p, [x, y, 0.040], speed=0.018, settle=4)
+
+
+def image_metrics(ink, target):
+    mine = ink >= 0.5
+    truth = target < 100
+    # Best whole-pixel registration within 5 mm, as in the task.
+    lim = int(round(5.0 / (PX_M * 1000)))
+    best = None
+    for dy in range(-lim, lim + 1):
+        for dx in range(-lim, lim + 1):
+            shifted = np.zeros_like(mine)
+            ys0, ys1 = max(0, dy), min(mine.shape[0], mine.shape[0] + dy)
+            xs0, xs1 = max(0, dx), min(mine.shape[1], mine.shape[1] + dx)
+            shifted[ys0:ys1, xs0:xs1] = mine[ys0 - dy:ys1 - dy, xs0 - dx:xs1 - dx]
+            inter = int(np.count_nonzero(shifted & truth))
+            union = int(np.count_nonzero(shifted | truth))
+            iou = inter / max(1, union)
+            if best is None or iou > best[0]:
+                best = (iou, dx, dy, shifted)
+    iou, dx, dy, aligned = best
+    dt_truth = cv2.distanceTransform((~truth).astype(np.uint8), cv2.DIST_L2, 5)
+    dt_mine = cv2.distanceTransform((~aligned).astype(np.uint8), cv2.DIST_L2, 5)
+    tol = 1.0 / (PX_M * 1000)
+    precision = float(np.count_nonzero(aligned & (dt_truth <= tol))) / max(1, int(aligned.sum()))
+    recall = float(np.count_nonzero(truth & (dt_mine <= tol))) / max(1, int(truth.sum()))
+    boundary_f = 2 * precision * recall / max(1e-9, precision + recall)
+    stray = float(np.count_nonzero(aligned & (dt_truth > tol))) / max(1, int(truth.sum()))
+    return {"iou": iou, "boundary_f": boundary_f, "boundary_precision": precision,
+            "boundary_recall": recall, "stray_frac_approx": stray,
+            "registration_px": [dx, dy], "target_px": int(truth.sum()), "mine_px": int(aligned.sum())}
+
+
+def run():
+    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+    s = Session(instance=INSTANCE, render=False)
+    s.reset()
+    p = s.primitives()
+    s.record_start()
+    move_to(s, p, [-0.100, 0.150, 0.055], speed=0.05)
+    move_to(s, p, [-0.100, 0.150, 0.027], speed=0.010, settle=6)
+    move_to(s, p, [-0.100, 0.150, 0.055], speed=0.03, settle=2)
+
+    for name, nodes, widths in STROKES:
+        draw_path(s, nodes, widths, name)
+
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    s.painter.finish()
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, f"{OUT}/trajectory.npz", meta={"generator": "gen.py", "strokes": [n for n, *_ in STROKES]})
+    ink = s.ink()
+    target_rgb = s.target_image()
+    target = cv2.cvtColor(target_rgb, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
+    local = image_metrics(ink, target)
+    records = s.strokes()
+    path_mm = sum(r["length_mm"] for r in records if r["sheet"] == "main" and r["inked"])
+    own_area = 0.0
+    for r in records:
+        if r["sheet"] == "main" and r["inked"]:
+            own_area += np.count_nonzero(np.asarray(r["mask"]) >= 128) * (PX_M * 1000) ** 2
+    local["path_mm"] = path_mm
+    local["mark_width_mm"] = own_area / max(path_mm, 1e-9)
+    local["n_strokes"] = len([r for r in records if r["sheet"] == "main"])
+    print("ACTIONS", actions.shape, "LOCAL", json.dumps(local, sort_keys=True))
+    print("STROKES", [(r["sheet"], r["inked"], round(r["length_mm"], 1), round(r["max_press_mm"], 1)) for r in records])
+    cv2.imwrite(f"{OUT}/candidate.png", cv2.cvtColor(s.canvas(), cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR))
+    print("REMOTE_SCORE", json.dumps(s.score(), sort_keys=True))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    run()
